annotations.title: Get SWAT+ engine source, build guide and toolchain

description:
Where the SWAT+ engine SWATGenX runs comes from (including its parallel/OpenMP build),
    and how to build it from source. Returns the public fork, the build guide with the exact
    toolchain, and whether building is needed at all (usually it is not — downloaded models run
    as-is). No authentication required.
name: get_engine_info
